title: tc-feedback-rubric
description: Structured rating of an answer: rubric scores, the failure type and the ideal answer, sent as one payload.

answer.description: The answer being rated – quoted at the top, and where the correction starts from

criteria.description: The criteria, each scored on its own scale

levels.description: The default scale for criteria without their own `levels`

failureTypes.description: The kinds of failure a person can pick, any number of them

value.description: The rating. Changed by the user unless a tc-value-change listener calls preventDefault()

meta.description: Sent along with the rating in tc-submit – ids and versions that tie it to the answer

sent.description: The rating was sent: the controls lock and "Edit rating" unlocks them. Set by Send; the app may set it too

sending.description: Shows Send as busy while the app saves the rating

submitLabel.description: The label on the send button

description.description: The question the criterion asks, in a line

levels.description: Its scale – defaults to the rubric's `levels`

optional.description: Can be sent without a score

label.description: A word for the level – "Good"; read after the number

description.description: What it means, in a line – shown as the toggle's tooltip
